query:
query GetGymBoardsForSwitcher($gymUuid: ID!) {
    gymBoards(gymUuid: $gymUuid) {
      
  uuid
  slug
  ownerId
  name
  boardType
  layoutId
  sizeId
  setIds
  angle
  isAngleAdjustable
  hasLeds
  isPublic
  isUnlisted
  locationName
  gymId
  gymUuid
  boardId
  canEdit

      hideLocation
      isOwned
      createdAt
      totalAscents
      uniqueClimbers
      followerCount
      commentCount
      isFollowedByMe
      isPinnedByMe
      gymName
      serialNumber
      timerName
    }
  }
